customReportSQL.SQLQuery:
DECLARE @StartDate date = '2026-01-01';
                 DECLARE @EndDate   date = '2026-08-17';
                 
                 SELECT
                     fsj.InvoiceID AS InvoiceNo,
                     c.CustomerName + ' - ' + c.AccountNumber AS Customer,
                     CASE
                         WHEN ot.OrderTypeID = 6
                             THEN 'Stock Orders - ' + bg.BuyinGroupName
                         ELSE ot.OrderTypeName + ' Orders - ' + bg.BuyinGroupName
                     END AS [Item (Product/Service)],
                     fsj.Patient AS Memo,
                     fsj.Total AS ItemAmount,
                     fsj.Total AS ItemRate,
                     CAST(fsj.InvoiceTime AS date) AS InvoiceDate,
                     CAST(DATEADD(DAY, 30, fsj.InvoiceTime) AS date) AS DueDate,
                     CASE
                         WHEN fsj.TaxAmount = 0 THEN 'VAT-0%'
                         ELSE 'VAT 17.5%'
                     END AS ItemTaxCode
                 FROM FinARSalesJournal AS fsj
                 INNER JOIN FinARPeriods AS fp
                     ON fp.FinARPeriodID = fsj.FinARPeriodID
                 INNER JOIN OrderTypes AS ot
                     ON ot.OrderTypeID = fsj.OrderType
                 INNER JOIN Customers AS c
                     ON c.CustomerID = fsj.CustomerID
                 LEFT JOIN BuyinGroups AS bg
                     ON bg.BuyinGroupID = c.BuyinGroupID
                 WHERE fsj.FinARPeriodID >= 74
                   AND (fsj.Patient <> 'FINANCE CHARGE' OR fsj.Patient IS NOT NULL)
                   AND ot.OrderType IN (1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 25, 26, 27, 30, 33, 36, 37)
                   AND (c.AccountNumber NOT IN ('3628', '1000', '1001', '650044', 'IDS', 'OSVS', 'BOS', 'PSMT')
                        OR c.AccountNumber IS NULL)
                   AND c.AccountNumber NOT LIKE '%ED'
                   AND (c.IsActive <> 0 OR c.IsActive IS NULL)
                   AND CAST(fsj.InvoiceTime AS date) ['BETWEEN'].[BetweenDateRange:'Report Date Range']
                 
                 UNION ALL
                 
                 SELECT
                     i.InvoiceID AS InvoiceNo,
                     c.CustomerName + ' - ' + c.AccountNumber AS Customer,
                     CASE
                         WHEN ot.OrderTypeID = 6
                             THEN 'Stock Orders - ' + bg.BuyinGroupName
                         ELSE ot.OrderTypeName + ' Orders - ' + bg.BuyinGroupName
                     END AS [Item (Product/Service)],
                     o.PatientID AS Memo,
                     i.Total AS ItemAmount,
                     i.Total AS ItemRate,
                     CAST(i.InvoiceTime AS date) AS InvoiceDate,
                     CAST(DATEADD(DAY, 30, i.InvoiceTime) AS date) AS DueDate,
                     CASE
                         WHEN i.TaxAmount = 0 THEN 'VAT-0%'
                         ELSE 'VAT 17.5%'
                     END AS ItemTaxCode
                 FROM Invoices AS i
                 LEFT JOIN Orders AS o
                     ON o.OrderID = i.OrderID
                 LEFT JOIN OrderTypes AS ot
                     ON ot.OrderTypeID = o.OrderType
                 LEFT JOIN Customers AS c
                     ON c.CustomerID = i.CustomerID
                 LEFT JOIN BuyinGroups AS bg
                     ON bg.BuyinGroupID = c.BuyinGroupID
                 WHERE ot.OrderType IN (1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 25, 26, 27, 30, 33, 36, 37)
                   AND c.AccountNumber = 'PSMT'
                   AND CAST(i.InvoiceTime AS date) ['BETWEEN'].[BetweenDateRange:'Report Date Range'];
